general_information.address: It’s 205 Rosedale Heights Drive… Toronto, Ontario. I think that’s how it goes, yes.
general_information.psychiatrist_name: SORRY, I’M BLANKING ON THE FULL NAME RIGHT THIS SECOND. IT’S DR. LAURA… SOMETHING BEGINNING WITH B, I THINK. IF YOU WANT, I CAN TRY TO GET THE REST OF IT STRAIGHT.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s… mostly since my son died. I keep feeling this heavy sadness and I can’t really concentrate, and everything just feels off. I’m trying to cope with that loss and get myself functioning again, but it’s been very hard.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to cope with the loss better, and be able to function again. And, I suppose, honour my son's memory somehow.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: Back in 1998 and again in 2003, by Dr. Laura Bennett, the psychiatrist. I… I know there were those two episodes, and she was involved then.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Depression. Just depression, from those two episodes.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — I had individual psychotherapy. It was back in 1998, and I think it was about 16 weekly sessions.; 1998.; About 16 weekly sessions.
